description: This script is a Perl program for creating a firmware image, replacing the brcmImagebuilder. It processes kernel and root filesystem images, constructs headers, and outputs a combined image, with options for different configurations and partitions.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads entire contents of a specified file into a scalar buffer.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates padding length needed to align size to a block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to align to specified block size.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Creates a firmware image with headers and embedded kernel and root filesystem, then writes to output file.
